mapper.insert: insert into sms_verification (phone, code_hash, purpose, expires_at, used_at, attempt_count, create_time) values (#{phone}, #{codeHash}, #{purpose}, #{expiresAt}, #{usedAt}, #{attemptCount}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from sms_verification where phone = #{phone} and purpose = #{purpose} order by create_time desc, id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update sms_verification set used_at = #{usedAt} where id = #{id} and used_at is null
mapper.insert: insert ignore into auth_sms_cooldown (phone, purpose, reservation_id, next_allowed_at) values (#{phone}, #{purpose}, #{reservationId}, #{nextAllowedAt})
mapper.update: update auth_sms_cooldown set reservation_id = #{reservationId}, next_allowed_at = #{nextAllowedAt} where phone = #{phone} and purpose = #{purpose} and next_allowed_at <= #{now}
mapper.delete: delete from auth_sms_cooldown where phone = #{phone} and purpose = #{purpose} and reservation_id = #{reservationId}
